# AI Business

> AI Business is an all-in-one customer management and growth platform for small businesses and entrepreneurs in Nigeria and across Africa. It helps businesses find customers, capture enquiries, follow up automatically, book appointments, and send professional invoices.

AI Business is a web-based software platform (SaaS). Primary audience: small business owners, solo entrepreneurs, and service providers. Primary market: Nigeria, available across Africa. Pricing: free forever plan (0 NGN) plus paid monthly tiers (6,000 / 15,000 / 45,000 NGN).

## Product pages

- [Home](https://ai-business-two-psi.vercel.app/): Overview, problem/solution, pricing, testimonials, signup.
- [Lead Finder](https://ai-business-two-psi.vercel.app/features/lead-finder): Find real local businesses and potential customers with contact details.
- [AI Receptionist](https://ai-business-two-psi.vercel.app/features/ai-receptionist): 24/7 automated answers to customer enquiries on your business page.
- [Appointments](https://ai-business-two-psi.vercel.app/features/appointments): Self-service booking page with automatic reminders.
- [Follow-Up Assistant](https://ai-business-two-psi.vercel.app/features/follow-up-assistant): AI-drafted follow-up messages for cold or quiet leads.
- [Invoicing](https://ai-business-two-psi.vercel.app/features/invoicing): Professional invoices with automatic payment reminders.
- [Business Page](https://ai-business-two-psi.vercel.app/features/business-page): Free professional public page for your business.
